name: Standard weighted polygenic score (Dudbridge 2013)
model_likelihood: Two traits as additive linear genetic effects plus environmental and unmodelled genetic residuals; liability-threshold extension for binary traits
prior: Random-effects distribution over markers; normal effects on standardised genotypes required for P-value-selection formulas; marginal least-squares weighting
inference_algorithm: Univariate least-squares regression per marker in training data; form weighted allele sums in independent replication subjects
estimand: Polygenic score; analytic association power, trait correlation, prediction MSE and binary-trait AUC
data_input: Training GWAS marker association estimates and ranking; individual genotypes and traits in independent replication sample
tunable_settings: Lower and upper marker-inclusion P-value thresholds; training/replication sample allocation; weighting scheme
